conditions.description: C1's Join (CY2023, first paid position 2023), Change and Renewal (CY2024) and Lapse (CY2025) take the six keys and flags from the attributes row of their segment Campaign Year.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-006: 2025 is carried from 2024. Standard set-up for every test: SetUp fakes silv_membership_events, fact_membership_events, silv_member_year_attributes, silv_event_amount (all with defaults), silv_payment_events, dim_payment_method, dim_payer_type, dim_concession_type (seeded with the reserved ids 0, -1, -2 and payment methods DD 1, Card 2, Bank transfer 3, Cheque 4, Corporate 5; payer types Individual 1, Corporate 2; concessions No concession 1, Retired 2, Exceptional Hardship 3), etl_run_log (identity, defaults) and etl_progress_log. A Join's amount Campaign Year is set consistently in silv_event_amount.amount_campaign_year and silv_payment_events. Here: attributes C1 2023 (DD 1, carried 0, payer 1, conc 1), 2024 (Card 2, 0), 2025 (Card 2, carried 1, payer 1 carried 1, conc 0), 2026 (Card, carried 1); payment events C1 2023 and 2024; events 101 JR:C1, 102 CH:C1:2024, 103 RN:C1:2024, 104 LP:C1:2025, all keys 0; amount rows for 101 (year 2023) and 103 (2024).
conditions.expected: After usp_load_silv_membership_events_segments: 101 (pm 1, 0, payer 1, 0, conc 1, 0); 102 and 103 (2, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0); 104 (2, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-001 C1 events take payment method and flags from their segment year attributes]

conditions.description: An event with no attributes row for its own contact and segment year gets 0 for every key and flag, replacing stale values; rows for the contact's other year or another contact in the same year do not apply.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes N1 2024 (DD) and N2 2025 (Card). Event 201 RN:N1:2025 holding stale values (pm 2 carried 1, payer 1 carried 1, conc 2 carried 1); event 202 CH:N3:2025 with no attributes for N3.
conditions.expected: Both events: payment_method_id 0, payer_type_id 0, concession_type_id 0 and all three carried flags 0, none NULL.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-002 event with no attributes row for its contact and year gets 0 keys and 0 flags]

conditions.description: After the silver and gold loads, no event in either table has a null payment_method_id and every value resolves to dim_payment_method, covering a method, Corporate, no attributes row (0), pre-2022 (-2) and Unrecognised (-1).
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes D1 2025 DD 1, D2 2025 Corporate 5, D4 2021 -2, D5 2025 -1; events 301 to 305 (D3's Change has no attributes row); fact rows mirror the silver events with defaults.
conditions.expected: 0 null or orphan payment_method_id in silver and in gold. Gold values: 301 1, 302 5, 303 0, 304 -2, 305 -1.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-003 no null payment method and every value resolves to dim_payment_method in silver and gold]

conditions.description: Counts of events by payment_method_id are the same in fact_membership_events as in silv_membership_events after both loads.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes E1 and E2 2025 DD 1, E3 2025 Card 2, E4 2025 Card carried 1; events 401 to 406 (two DD Renewals, a Card Renewal and Change for E3, a Lapse for E4, a Renewal for E5 with no attributes); fact rows mirror silver.
conditions.expected: Silver and gold both give pm 0: 1, pm 1: 2, pm 2: 3.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-004 gold counts by payment method equal silver counts]

conditions.description: C7 joins in CY2023 (attributes Card) with first paid position in 2024 (attributes Direct Debit). The Join takes its segments from 2024, its amount Campaign Year, not its own year or a later one.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes C7 2023 (Card 2, payer 0, conc 0), 2024 (DD 1, payer 1, conc 1), 2025 (Bank transfer 3, conc 3); payment events C7 2024 and 2025; event 501 JR:C7 (CY2023); amount row for 501 with amount_campaign_year 2024.
conditions.expected: 501: payment_method_id 1 (Direct Debit), carried 0, payer_type_id 1, carried 0, concession_type_id 1, carried 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-005 C7 join takes Direct Debit from its first paid position year not its own year]

conditions.description: C1's 2024 Renewal has payment_method_carried 0 and its 2025 Lapse payment_method_carried 1, in silver and in gold.
conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-006: 2025 carries 2024's Card. Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes C1 2023 to 2025 as TC-012-001; events 103 RN:C1:2024 and 104 LP:C1:2025; fact rows mirror silver. Both loads run.
conditions.expected: Silver and gold: 103 (Card 2, carried 0); 104 (Card 2, carried 1).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-006 C1 renewal carried 0 and lapse carried 1 in silver and gold]

conditions.description: Each of the three carried flags on an event equals the same flag on its attributes row (flags set differently per column so a swap shows), in silver and gold, and none is null.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes F1 2025 flags (pm 1, payer 0, conc 1), F2 2025 flags (0, 1, 0); events 701 RN:F1, 702 CH:F1, 703 RN:F2, 704 CH:F3 (no attributes); fact rows mirror silver. Both loads run.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-007 each carried flag on events equals the same flag on the attributes row in silver and gold]

conditions.description: C13 joins in CY2024 and has no paid position in any year (another contact has one). The Join takes its own year's Card, not the next year's.

Attributes C13 2024 (Card 2, payer 0, conc 1), 2025 (DD 1 carried 1); payment event only for C99 (2023); event 801 JR:C13 CY2024; amount row with amount_campaign_year 2024.
conditions.expected: 801: payment_method_id 2 (Card), carried 0, payer_type_id 0, carried 0, concession_type_id 1, carried 0.

conditions.description: After the change, neither event table has subs_amount, fee_amount, invoiced_subtotal, credited_amount, currency_id, fee_amount_gbp, credited_amount_gbp or net_amount_gbp; both keep the nine segment and amount columns with the design's types and nullability.
conditions.preconditions: Reads the deployed table definitions from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS; no rows are needed.
conditions.expected: 0 of the eight dropped columns on either table. On each of silv_membership_events and fact_membership_events: payment_method_id, payer_type_id, concession_type_id int NOT NULL; the three carried flags bit NOT NULL; subs_amount_gbp and invoiced_subtotal_gbp decimal(19,4) NULL; amount_status varchar(30) NULL.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-012 event tables drop the eight unsupplied amount columns and keep the nine segment and amount columns]

conditions.description: Change and Lapse events get null subs_amount_gbp, invoiced_subtotal_gbp and amount_status in silver and gold, replacing stale values, while the same contact-year's Renewal carries its amount.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes L1 2025; events 1301 RN:L1:2025, 1302 CH:L1:2025 and 1303 LP:L1:2025, the Change and Lapse holding stale 100.00 / 100.00 / 'Invoiced'; amount row for 1301 only (450.00, 'Invoiced'); fact rows mirror silver. Both loads run.
conditions.expected: Silver and gold: 1301 (450.0000, 450.0000, 'Invoiced'); 1302 and 1303 (NULL, NULL, NULL).
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-013 change and lapse events have null amounts and amount_status in silver and gold]

conditions.description: Design: Join, Renewal and Readmission take subs_amount_gbp, invoiced_subtotal_gbp and amount_status from silv_event_amount by event_nk, including nulls and 0.00; an amount row for an event that does not exist adds no event.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Events 1401 RN:R1, 1402 RA:R1, 1403 RN:F1, 1404 RN:N8 (stale 999.00 'Invoiced'), 1405 RN:B1:2021, 1406 JR:J3 (amount year 2025, payment event J3 2025). Amount rows: 1401 NULL 'Counted on another event', 1402 900.00 'Invoiced', 1403 0.00 'Full Concession', 1404 NULL 'No invoice', 1405 NULL 'Before invoice data', 1406 200.00 'Invoiced', and RN:GONE:2025 (event 1499, not in the events table).
conditions.expected: Exactly six events: 1401 (NULL, NULL, 'Counted on another event'); 1402 (900.0000, 900.0000, 'Invoiced'); 1403 (0.0000, 0.0000, 'Full Concession'); 1404 (NULL, NULL, 'No invoice'); 1405 (NULL, NULL, 'Before invoice data'); 1406 (200.0000, 200.0000, 'Invoiced').
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-014 join renewal and readmission take amounts and amount_status from silv_event_amount by event_nk]

conditions.description: Across R1, R2 and R3, the sums of subs_amount_gbp and invoiced_subtotal_gbp and the counts by amount_status are equal in fact_membership_events and silv_membership_events, and both tables keep their event row count.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Events 1501 to 1506 (R1 Renewal and Readmission, R2 Renewal and Readmission, R3 Renewal and Change); amount rows R1 RN NULL 'Counted on another event', R1 RA 900.00, R2 RN NULL 'Counted on another event', R2 RA 450.00, R3 RN 820.00; fact rows mirror silver. Both loads run.
conditions.expected: Silver and gold: SUM(subs_amount_gbp) 2170.0000, SUM(invoiced_subtotal_gbp) 2170.0000, 6 rows each; counts 'Invoiced' 3, 'Counted on another event' 2, NULL 1 in both.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-015 R1 R2 R3 amount sums and amount_status counts agree in silver and gold]

conditions.description: R1's 2025 attributes row is Card (from INV-2, the later invoice), so both R1 2025 events, the Renewal and the Readmission, carry Card in silver and gold.

Attributes R1 2025 (Card 2, carried 0, segment invoice 160102); events 1601 RN:R1:2025 and 1602 RA:R1:2025 with their amount rows; fact rows mirror silver. Both loads run.
conditions.expected: Silver and gold: 1601 and 1602 both payment_method_id 2, carried 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-016 R1 renewal and readmission both carry Card from the 2025 attributes row in silver and gold]

conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes K1 2025 (conc 2, carried 0), 2026 (conc 2, carried 1); events 1701 RN:K1:2025, 1702 CH:K1:2025, 1703 LP:K1:2026; amount row for 1701; fact rows mirror silver. Both loads run.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-017 K1 2025 events carry Retired concession carried 0 in silver and gold]

conditions.description: No event in silver or gold has a null concession_type_id, and every value resolves to dim_concession_type: No concession, Retired, Exceptional Hardship, no attributes row (0), pre-2022 (-2) and Unrecognised (-1).
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes M1 2025 conc 1, M2 2, M3 3, M5 2021 -2, M6 2025 -1; events 1801 to 1806 (M4 Change has no attributes); fact rows mirror silver. Both loads run.
conditions.expected: 0 null or orphan concession_type_id in silver and gold. Gold values: 1801 1, 1802 2, 1803 3, 1804 0, 1805 -2, 1806 -1.

conditions.preconditions: assumes Q-011. Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Attributes K9 2021 (-2, -2, -2, flags 0) and 2022 (conc Retired 2); event 1901 RN:K9:2021; amount row 'Before invoice data'.
conditions.expected: 1901: concession_type_id -2, concession_type_carried 0.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-019 K9 2021 renewal has concession type Not applicable]

conditions.description: Design: the silver load updates only rows whose new-column values differ, so a second run on unchanged data changes nothing and logs 0 updated.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Data as TC-012-007 (events 2001 to 2004) plus amount rows for the two Renewals (450.00 and 380.00). The load runs twice. Layer and step name are not asserted: the design does not state them.
conditions.expected: silv_membership_events identical in every column after both runs. etl_run_log rows in order: ('Success', inserted 0 or NULL, updated 3, deleted 0 or NULL) and ('Success', 0, 0, 0); event 2004, already 0, is not counted.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-020 silver rerun on unchanged data changes nothing and logs 0 updated]

conditions.description: Design: the silver load never inserts or deletes events and never touches Phase 1 columns; it updates only rows that differ, and logs Success with its count.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Event 2101 already holds the values its attributes and amount rows give; 2102 (membership_status_id 2) holds stale zeros; 2103 (a Change) holds stale amounts. Attributes also exist for H9, which has no event.
conditions.expected: Phase 1 columns and row set unchanged (3 events, no H9 event). New columns: 2101 (2, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 450.0000, 450.0000, 'Invoiced'); 2102 (1, 0, 1, 0, 3, 0, 300.0000, 300.0000, 'Invoiced'); 2103 (4, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, NULL, NULL, NULL). One etl_run_log row: 'Success', updated 2, inserted and deleted 0 or NULL, finished_at set, error_message NULL.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-021 silver load updates only differing rows and never inserts deletes or touches Phase 1 columns]

conditions.description: Error path (design: try/catch with XACT_ABORT, error logged through usp_etl_log_end, re-raised): a write the target rejects re-raises, logs Failed and leaves silv_membership_events unchanged, including another row's pending update.
conditions.preconditions: Runs without the tSQLt transaction. Standard set-up (TC-012-001). The load's sources have the same types as its target, so no source value can overflow; a test-only CHECK on the faked silv_membership_events rejects payment_method_id 99 instead. Attributes X1 2025 Card 2 and XERR 2025 payment method 99; events 2201 RN:X1:2025 and 2202 RN:XERR:2025, both 0.
conditions.expected: Error 547 reaches the caller. silv_membership_events identical in every column to before (2201 still 0). etl_run_log holds one row, status 'Failed', with a non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-022 silver write the target rejects re-raises logs Failed and changes nothing]

conditions.description: Design: the gold load copies only the nine new columns by event_id and updates only rows that differ; membership_status_id and the other Phase 1 fact columns keep the Phase 1 gold values even where silver differs.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Silver 2301 (membership_status_id 2, Corporate 5, payer 2, conc 2, 380.00 'Invoiced') and 2302 (DD values, 450.00). Fact 2301 has membership_status_id 1 and stale zeros; fact 2302 already equals silver.
conditions.expected: Fact Phase 1 columns and row set unchanged (2301 still membership_status_id 1). New columns equal silver: 2301 (5, 0, 2, 0, 2, 0, 380.0000, 380.0000, 'Invoiced'), 2302 (1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 450.0000, 450.0000, 'Invoiced'). etl_run_log: 'Success', updated 1, inserted and deleted 0 or NULL.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-023 gold load copies only the new columns and updates only differing rows]

conditions.description: A second gold load on unchanged silver changes nothing and logs 0 updated.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Silver 2401 (Renewal, Card, 450.00 'Invoiced') and 2402 (Lapse, Card carried 1); fact rows hold zeros. The gold load runs twice.
conditions.expected: fact_membership_events identical in every column after both runs. etl_run_log rows in order: ('Success', 0, 2, 0) and ('Success', 0, 0, 0), inserted and deleted read as 0 where NULL.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-024 gold rerun on unchanged data changes nothing and logs 0 updated]

conditions.description: Design: a failed silver-to-gold check (counts by payment_method_id, counts by amount_status, amount sums) fails the gold load. Silver holds an event that gold lacks, so the counts cannot agree; the error reaches the caller, the run is logged Failed and the fact is unchanged.
conditions.preconditions: Runs without the tSQLt transaction. Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Silver 2501 (Card, 450.00) and 2502 (DD, 300.00); fact holds only 2501 with zeros. The error number is not asserted, because the design does not state it, but a missing object, column or parameter (201, 207, 208, 2812) does not count. Fact unchanged follows the design's error handling (try/catch with XACT_ABORT, rolled back, re-raised).
conditions.expected: An error reaches the caller. fact_membership_events identical in every column to before (2501 still zeros, no 2502 row). etl_run_log holds one row, status 'Failed', with a non-NULL error_message.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-025 gold check failure when silver and gold row sets differ re-raises logs Failed and changes nothing]

conditions.description: The gold load copies all nine new columns from silver by event_id, including carried flags of 1, a null amount and 0.00, replacing stale gold values.
conditions.preconditions: Standard set-up (TC-012-001). Silver 2601 RA:Z1 (5, 1, 2, 1, 2, 1, 425.50, 425.50, 'Invoiced'), 2602 RN:Z1 (same keys, NULL, NULL, 'Counted on another event'), 2603 RN:Z2 (3, 0, 1, 0, 3, 0, 0.00, 0.00, 'Fully credited'). Fact rows hold zeros, and 2602 a stale 100.00 'Invoiced'.
conditions.test_ref: [test_MOD012].[test TC-012-026 gold copies all nine new column values from silver by event_id]
